articleTitle: Real-Time Face Mask Detector
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: When the COVID-19 pandemic was present we all have faced various challenges in our everyday lives. Pandemic created worldwide emergency which led to the lockdown in most of the countries resulting into disruption in world trade and movement. To reduce the covid cases WHO recommended to wear mask and maintain social distancing and then these steps became mandatory for some places, such as restaurants, hospitals, grocery stores etc., The purpose of limiting interaction with individuals as much as possible in such situations is simply defeated by having a staff personally check each person to make sure their mask is on. To avoid this dilemma, it became necessary to build a project named ‘Real-time face mask detector’, This reveals whether a mask-wearing individual is there. This project needed the use of some python libraries like TensorFlow, Keras, OpenCV. Using this project, we will be able to Detect mask-on faces in live video clip with accuracy of 97-98 %.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Analysis of Machine LearningTechniques for Parkinson’s disease Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: PD (Parkinson’s Disease) is a widespread health concern that is getting more frequent by the day and has had an influence on many countries. Its diagnosis is mostly based on symptom analysis, and it impairs mobility, coordination, and muscular control. Tremors, stiffness, delayed movement, and trouble walking are common signs of the condition, as stated by doctors. Furthermore, alterations in voice are highly prevalent in PD patients, however Some tweaks are not immediately detectable at a preliminary phase. The condition would alter our respiration, tone of voice, and loudness by up to ten decibels. Several research have demonstrated that one of the first signs of PD is changes in speech, hence a Parkinson dataset containing biomedical human voice is employed. As a result, speech recognition has the potential to bring a novel approach to the evaluation and treatment of Parkinson’s disease. The goal of this review is to give comparative research on the methodologies created using machine learning techniques in Parkinson’s disease diagnosis. Machine Learning algorithms are being used to treat Parkinson’s disease. A data collection of speech characteristics is used to determine whether and someone is in good health. If impacted, the harshness may be determined and likely treated accordingly. Models such as Random Forest classification, K Nearest Neighbour, XGBoost and Support Vector Machine are used in the suggested study. Principal component analysis is also used to minimize the amount of characteristics (PCA). These models’ performance is assessed and contrasted. Using the PD dataset, these models achieve an accuracy of 70% to 91%. Superior performance models are being explored for ensembles as well as to improve overall performance standards. The ensemble of models is employed to achieve the greatest accuracy of 91% and exact disease detection.

articleTitle: Analysis of Key Based Cryptographic Algorithms and its Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: Information security is the process of safeguarding data. It safeguards its availability, privacy, and integrity. The capacity to secure data from attacks, as well as efficiency and speed are the two key features that separate one cryptography algorithm from another. Security is the most difficult issue in the present world, and the various security dangers in data security must be avoided in order to provide consumers with more privacy while still permitting high information availability and Integrity. Data encryption employing various data encryption techniques will increase the security of data transmission. This paper primarily focuses on a comparative analysis of symmetric algorithms (AES, DES, Ceaser Cipher, Stream Cipher) and asymmetric algorithms (Diffie Hellman, RSA), and also file and image encryption using symmetric algorithms.

articleTitle: Morphology of Red Blood Cells Classification using Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: Poikilocytosis is a condition in which the shape of RBC cells changes regularly. This condition is arising from several anemias and other diseases. It is critical to detect and classify abnormal RBC shapes as early as possible to diagnose and treat the condition. The proposed four different deep Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) are for RBC morphology classification, which is beneficial to hematologists. After using the data augmentation strategy, deep CNN produces good results and improves the performance of the models. The proposed deep CNN is tested on the recently available Erythrocytes IDB datasets. In Erythrocytes, there are three versions of IDB datasets IDB 1, IDB 2, and IDB 3. The proposed deep CNN models obtained an accuracy of 97.77 %, 96.28 %, 96.10 %, and 95.95 % and outperformed existing benchmark methods. The proposed CNN models produce good accuracy, speed, and classification rate results.

articleTitle: A Profound Method for Three-Tier Toxic Word Classification using LSTM-RNN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: Text classification is the activity of labeling natural language texts with relevant categories from a predefined set. In the research work, The words are categorized from a sentence according to their toxicity and according to modification will be done. As Online platforms such as social media provide opportunities to users to express their thoughts and their opinions on various topics and incidents. Due to the different opinion of every individual, an explicit language in some cases which hurt the readers. So, to solve a novel method is proposed by building a model wherein toxic words are categorized into three classes in keeping with their toxicity. In the primary class, words that are least toxic are indicated through crimson traces to the person, withinside the secondary class words are extra poisonous than the primary one, and again and again. The use of those phrases through individual, that words will be eliminated automatically and withinside the remaining or third class, words are the maximum toxic in assessment than that of the first and second class, through the use of those phrases’ person account could be deleted/blocked. As a punishment, the account will be blocked for a specific time period and the length could be improved as in increasing of the occurrences of those words.

articleTitle: AI-Based Deep Learning Chatbot for Career and Personal Mentorship
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: Mentoring is an inseparable part of any student’s life. As the level of education increases, every student requires support and guidance regarding career choice, program and major selection, as well as individual and personal counseling. The proposed system has been made to meet this facility, where a student can express themselves anonymously, and without any criticism and partiality. The chat-bot will be used to interact with the student regarding their professional and personal life both, which will solve their issues and doubts based on the questions they have asked. The student will input their query through text, and the bot will generate an output best suited in the student’s interest. The proposed system created can provide the students with an alternative to hectic and physical mentoring sessions.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of a Healthcare Unit
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: The most important aspect of any country is its healthcare system, but many healthcare providers struggle to provide patients with practical and innovative services. The current emergency clinics are outfitted with cutting-edge technology to save as many lives as possible given the situation. Automation contributes to improved patient health outcomes by assisting technological breakthroughs. Automation can also notify medical staff of known drug interactions and contraindications by querying a database. In this study, we used IoT technologies and Cisco Packet Tracer software to construct a smart hospital system. The system incorporates IoT devices, guarded medical wards, automated electrical appliances, and fire alarm systems. The Cisco Packet Tracer’s characteristics can be used to simulate a smart hospital. Results from the simulation demonstrate that smart objects may successfully connect to the hospital server, raising the possibility of application in the real world.

articleTitle: MPPT for a Solar PV Array: ANN and P&O Comparison
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: In this study, an intelligent system that quickly and accurately determines a PV array’s maximum power point by using an artificial neural network is discussed. Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) algorithms for solar photovoltaic (PV) systems are being developed so that we can capture maximum power from varying irradiance (sunlight) and temperature to ensure maximum output power. In this work, two methods of such MPPT techniques are discussed and compared using the same standalone PV system. Two algorithms, the perturb and observe (P&O) and artificial neural network (ANN), are explored and contrasted. Both these methods are used to extract the maximum output power from the PV array and then are compared to determine the better and more efficient option in terms of time consumed to execute the algorithm and the efficiency at which the power is extracted. The simulations required for this project are designed, coded, and executed in MATLAB environment. The ANN has a noticeably better responsiveness when compared to P&O.

articleTitle: Mobile Based Application For Tea Leaf Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: Tea plant leaf diseases are one of the grand challenges that face in agriculture sector worldwide. In India approximately 20% to 30% of the leaves are lost due to various diseases each year. Tea leaf disease identification is challenging for limited-resources farmers if performed through optical observation of plant leaves symptoms. Therefore, it is important to catch the spread of the disease can spread of the disease in its early stage before they reach epidemic proportion otherwise the disease can spread quickly throughout the entire plantation resulting in huge losses for the farmers. To aid the farmers in the crucial task of identifying tea leaf diseases in its early stage. it is practical to have an intelligent system for detection,identification and classification system in place as a preventive measure. This proposed model is a ML powered mobile based system to automate the plant leaf disease diagnosis process. The developed system uses CNN for feature reduction and classifying five diseases categories. The user interface is developed as a mobile application, allowing farmers to capture a photo of the infected Tea plant leaves. Captured image is then uploaded into the Database and then into the algorithm by specifying image path.It then displays the disease category and symptoms of disease along with the confidence percentage.This solutionwill be user friendly and will perform in an effective and efficient manner. It is expected that this system would create a better opportunity for farmers to keep their crops healthy and eliminate the use of wrong fertilizers that could stress the plants.

articleTitle: Setup and Hold Time Analysis of D Flip-Flop based on CMOS and GNRFET
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: Graphene Nano Ribbon (GNR) based transistor can be considered as one of the alternative for the silicon elements for future integrated circuits. This paper introduces design and characterization of sequential circuit based on Graphene Nano-Ribbon Field-Effect Transistors (GNRFETs) as well as CMOS. Circuit simulation and analysis is done using Synopsys HSPICE simulator.Pass Transistor Logic (PTL) based D-flip-flopis designed for clock frequency of 4GHz. The proposed GNRFET PTL based D Flip-flop shows notable performance improvement in comparison with the conventional CMOS based technology.Setup time and hold time analysis is also performed and compared.

articleTitle: Prediction and Detection of Liver Diseases using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: Liver is a very essential organ in the human body. It is essential to recognize or diagnose the disease early. This considerably aids in the early avoidance of disease with minimal medication. Conventional methods include Liver Function Tests and test results. Early detection of liver disease is very difficult. This is because symptoms of the disease become apparent only in the later stages of the disease. This system of Machine learning facilitates early disease detection, Identifying elements that lead to fatal liver impairment. Predicting the disease in its early stages is a difficult task for doctors and scientists due to the apparently sensitive signs. Effects will become apparent only when it is too late. The initiative seeks to use machine learning techniques to address this issue and improve the victims of the disease. Because there are few signs of liver disease, it is difficult to diagnose and symptoms usually do not appear until it is too late. The aim is to study and use a classification approach to distinguish between liver disease and healthy individuals, if diseased then further classified into the level of disease and its type. Also, precautions are provided for any symptoms. Consequently, ML techniques have identified liver disease in individuals.

articleTitle: Solder Joint Defect Detection in PCBA Chip Components Based on the Histogram Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: Manufacturing of defect-free Assembled Printed Circuit Board has gained a lot of importance due to its various benefits such as high assembly compactness, small size, and worthy quality. This paper is mainly focusing on the identification and localization improper solder joints in the assembled PCBs. In this work, a non-contact and referential based algorithm is developed for the inspection of real assembled Printed Circuit Boards defects. In this approach firstly the region of every component present in both reference image which is having no defect and Test image will be extracted using template matching technique. The Histogram of region of interest is obtained and analyzed for good and defected components. Based on the comparison of histogram of good and defected components, statistical model is developed to identify the solder joints defects. Finally, the location of the defect will be highlighted on the test PCB image. The experimentation shows that the proposed method successfully performs the identification and localization of solders joints defects with a minimum inspection time of around 321. 494msec which is 20% of the time taken compared to all other previous method and also results in 96.25% of accuracy which is better than the other methods.

articleTitle: Sign Language Interpreter for Law Enforcement
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: Software that helps Law Enforcement to keep track of statements in sign language is currently not available in the market. Although other available programs are incredibly efficient, they might be very challenging to determine whether your hand movements are correct.Those programs are less user-friendly because it takes a lot of time to learn how to use it. Apart from that some of the software need hardware support to make the detection accurate. This paper, describe how to employ this model/project effectively while putting together a course on interactive sign language instruction.This project will make it easier to record statements from a deaf or dumb person more accurately and consistently. Additionally, A text-to-speech converter would allow for both listening and seeing the text in sign language. Sign language products such as this appear to be a very helpful tool for law enforcement as well as the deaf persons.Such a translator might be useful for individuals who have been victims of incorrect sign language translation, such as deaf and stupid people.

articleTitle: Secure Splitting of Bills and Managing Expenditure Using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: After its introduction in Web 3.0, blockchain has become the dominant technology for securely transferring data through decentralized peer-to-peer systems. Blockchain is an unchangeable ledger that enables safe, decentralized transaction execution. This paper proposes a system for dividing group expenses and managing expenses that employs blockchain technology for data security. In this project, we will integrate Blockchain technology with a web client so that users can easily access the application. This application will save all of the user’s transaction data in a secure manner, ensuring that the data is not tampered by anyone. Also, options for dividing the bill equally and unequally are also available. This application will also keep a track of user’s expenses, this feature will help them to manage their expenses accordingly.

articleTitle: Person Recognition using Gait Energy Image, MobileNetV3Small and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: In the past few decades, gait as a biometric attribute has garnered a lot of attention for its application in a broad variety of security and privacy-related scenarios, including identity recognition and authentication. The deployment of surveillance cameras allows for the collection of Gait data, which is a non-invasive form of identification that is based on a biometric trait that can be seen from a distance and can be utilized for identifying reasons. It is difficult to create reliable automatic gait identification systems since Gait can be modified by several covariate parameters. Some of these covariate elements include garments, walking tempo, camera view angle. In this work, a method for recognizing people with a high degree of accuracy is demonstrated. This paper makes use of the Gait Energy Image, MobileNetV3Sma11 model, and Machine Learning to develop an approach to recognize person using Gait pattern. The paper includes experimental findings, including precision, recall, f1-score, and classification accuracy, all of which point to the effectiveness of the suggested method.

articleTitle: An autonomous robot for removing Underwater pollution : OCTACLEANER
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: In the contemporary world, in which all life forms, counting with aquatic life, are stricken by global warming, there are various answers for numerous kinds of problems, however there’s very moderate interest paid to the waste that is amassing underwater. The waste that we dump into bodies of water does not simply float, but settles under water after a period of time. To resolve this, we proposed a solution in the form of an octopus-like robot named OCTACLEANER. This robot would help in the removal of trash accumulated beneath, with the added benefit of removing muck.

articleTitle: Micro-patterning of aluminium-induced crystalline-silicon through reactive ion etching to fabricate pressure-sensing devices
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: Flexibility and miniaturization are crucial towards building ‘smart skin’, which has the potential to perform real-time sensing of several stimuli together. A low-temperature process using aluminum-induced crystallization (AIC) has been explored for the fabrication of piezoresistive polycrystalline silicon. Low temperature allows deposition of AIC-Silicon on flexible polyimide (Kapton) substrate at a lower thermal budget. In this work, AIC-Silicon with a high gauge factor of 42 has been synthesized over the Kapton substrate. Further, it has been patterned to form a device as per the design using two different processes – one with photolithography, lift off and Al wet etching, and another with photolithography along with reactive ion etching (RIE). Device is designed in the form of Wheatstone bridge consisting of four piezo-resistors made of polycrystalline silicon film obtained by AIC. While using RIE, with a DC bias of -25V applied to the substrate electrode and using sulphur hexafluoride gas flow rate of 10 sccm, high etch selectivity of 7.8 is obtained for AIC-Si with respect to the photoresist. Devices patterned with RIE demonstrated low line edge roughness (within 1 micron), leading to a variation in resistance values of the four resistors in the Wheatstone bridge to within 19.3%. On the contrary, devices patterned without RIE showed line edge roughness up to 10 microns which caused a variation of resistance values up to 93.8%. Subsequently the array of four sensors was fabricated using the RIE process flow.

articleTitle: Proposed Method for Threat Detection Using User Behavior Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: The development of a unique Web-Based platform to identify malicious user activity is the motivation of this research. Paper has applied analytics to the application-layer logs and proposed a Random Forest Algorithm-based model to certain metrics to identify malicious users. The paper shows collected IP addresses and device IDs from web application logs and has then applied the random forest algorithm to establish the behavior of users based on their browsing patterns. In this paper, the identification of the behavior is based on the number of requests made by the user, the time spent on the web application, and the frequency of requests. The patterns with the highest number of requests, the longest time spent, and the highest frequency of requests is the most probable cases of malicious user behavior. have created a Password manager web application and introduced vulnerabilities in training data intentionally for this purpose. The paper shows hosted setup on the LAMP stack based on the AWS EC2 cloud. These patterns would be used to sort incoming traffic and flag any IP addresses that would be the most probable cases of unauthorized login attempts.

articleTitle: First Principles Entrepreneurial Effectuation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: This study presents a conceptual framework on ‘First Principles Entrepreneurial Effectuation’ and indicates that means-path-end is a better framework to understand how entrepreneurial people reason about specific problems in their path from a given set of means to new imagined ends. This study further shares the findings of an exploratory research with startup entrepreneurial respondents considering the suggested conceptual framework. Entrepreneurial can reason by first principles or by analogy in their path from a given set of means to new imagined ends. The imagined ends are different based on different reasonings on the path to solve problems and it is indicated that potentially ‘First Principles’ based imagined ends can result to better value outcomes as part of proposed conceptual framework. This study opens a dimension for further empirical research to substantiate the suggested conceptual framework. This study can impact the newer generations in setting the entrepreneurial path for ‘visiondriven company’ in an ‘elemental cost optimal’ manner.

articleTitle: Fiber Bragg Grating based Wearable Device for Monitoring Respiratory Activity
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: Respiratory rate is a critical physiological measure examined in a clinical setting for early detection of illnesses such as COVID – 19 and acute respiratory distress syndrome, which is caused by fluid accumulation in the lungs, preventing air from filling the lungs. In the present work, a wearable device based on a Fiber Bragg Grating (FBG) sensor is developed. The FBG sensor is bonded to PVC oxygen mask and the wearable device is analyzed for the feasibility of adopting it for real-time respiratory rate monitoring in a non-invasive manner. Various phases in a breathing pattern are captured by the FBG sensor and the respiration rate is computed using the optical wearable device. Preliminary trials show that the sensor is effective in measuring the respiratory rate for normal, slow and rapid breathing patterns. The results obtained indicate about 20 breaths per minute for normal breathing and around 10 and 35 breaths per minute for slow and rapid breathing respectively. Small size, lightweight, and high flexibility are the pros of the proposed device compared to electronic sensors. Since it is immune to electromagnetic interferences, the wearable device can be used in some special environments such as Magnetic Resonance.

articleTitle: YOLOV3 based Real Time Drone Detection for Counter Drone System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: Nowadays, surveillance across the borders is a major issue since the dropping and supply of ammunition, explosives, and weapons is done using drones. In this paper, an implementation of YOLO based drone detection and recognition was implemented for surveillance applications. Drones are unmanned aircraft that may be remotely piloted (ground control) and come in a variety of sizes and configurations for use in a variety of applications. Lawbreakers employ drones for unlawful operations despite restrictions on their use in sensitive areas being in place because they are inexpensive and easy to use. To detect drones in real time and with high accuracy, a deep learning-based object detection model (YOLOv3) is trained on a specific dataset in this study.

articleTitle: Power Quality Assessment in a renewable energy penetrated distribution system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: Poor power quality (PQ) is one of the major issues of the renewable energy sources (RES) integrated distribution network (DN) due to the increased use of power semiconductor devices. Compromised PQ can leads to huge loss of revenue as a result of misguiding decision making by the utility engineer. Therefore, accurate assessment of power disturbances is becomes an important task in order to provide an effective PQ management. The main aim of this article is to report a complete PQ evaluation in a distribution generation (DG) integrated power system. In this regard, the paper suggest a novel composite PQ index (CPQI) which is based on six different PQ indices such as voltage imbalance-factor, voltage-score, total-harmonic-distortion of voltage and current, power factor and frequency-regulation-factor. An analytic hierarchy process is additionally used in order to introduce the weights for each PQ indices during the calculation of CPQI. The foremost importance is on reckoning the over-all quality of the power supply in different operating scenario of RES penetrated DN such as DG outage, DG synchronization and islanding. The obtained result shows that the suggested CPQI is well-capable to estimate the over-all PQ under different operating and loading condition of the DG penetrated DN.

articleTitle: A Reliable Method for Establishing a Common Time synchronization in Mobile Ad Hoc Networks in VANET.
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: Recently, new networks have been developed that integrate mobile ad hoc networks with fog computing. These networks, often referred to as vehicular ad-hoc networks (VANETs), may be used for several purposes, such as traffic monitoring, intelligent driving, and safe driving. of a heterogeneous network is the fog-based VANET. which consists of both static and dynamic nodes in The network heterogeneity causes a significant clock rate difference across the nodes in a fog-based VANET. nodes’ clocks losing their accuracy and cause problems like inaccurate duty cycle scheduling and erroneous event sequencing.Several message exchanges must occur between the nodes to synchronise the clocks. In this work, this paper propose a method to synchronise the time. In this method, a group of nodes is selected to communicate to disseminate temporal information over the whole network, as opposed to having each node contact with the nodesclose to it. The time synchronisation protocol proposed can adapt to the high nodal velocity and random changes in the network topology while maintaining high accuracy and resistance to node failure and packet loss. The combination of NS2 simulators used to carry out the protocol simulation to assess the system performance has produced persuasive findings, exceeding those shown by the basic protocols.

articleTitle: Assessment of power system voltage stability using ANN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: A safe operation of power systems was exposed to several environmental and economic obstacles, especially in developing countries, which affected the stability of the system and its ability to provide power. The stability of the voltage is very important factor through which the state of the system and its ability to supply electrical power can be known continuously. If this problem persists for long periods or the appropriate, correct, and quick action is not taken directly to protect the power grid system from the great damage that may occur due to the instability of the voltage. In this research paper, the problem of voltage stability monitoring was addressed by voltage stability indices using Artificial Neural Network ANN, which provides very effective and high-accuracy tool for monitoring. The smart Feed Forward Backpropagation Neural Network was used to monitor the Voltage stability indexes VSIs of the power system 9 IEEE buses and verify the validity of the results of the used neural network by the most common load flow analysis method Newton-Raphson for the system under different types of reactive power conditions which consider as the main cause of the voltage instability in order to prove the high accuracy and ability of the smart algorithm of the Feed Forward Backpropagation Neural Network to monitor the stability of the power system voltage as high effective tool.

Author Keywords: Feed Forward Backpropagation Neural Network FFBPNN

articleTitle: Banking and financial-services contribute Country Cities combat COVID-19 pandemic Block Chain technology and its application
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: Block chain is a technology that is used to save the record of all information related to crypto currency transactions in a public ledger. Digital currency transactions can be done without any third party. When a coin is transferred by a computer, its information reaches all the computers connected to the network, and the transaction is verified. After this, the transaction data is secured by encoding it in blocks using cryptography technology. Similarly, many types of blocks together form the Public Ledger, which is called Block chain. During this hackathon, the winners will also be awarded up to three lakh rupees. Block chain has been the topic of discussion all over the world in recent times. Ever since the crypto currency era began, block chain has come into the limelight more and more, because crypto currency works on block chain technology itself.

articleTitle: An Open-Source Static Timing Analysis EDA Tool for Digital System Design
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: Static timing analysis (STA) is an EDA tool used for Digital System Design to compute the expected delay/timing of a synchronous digital circuit without requiring a simulation of the full circuit. High-performance VLSI designs have traditionally been characterized by the clock frequency at which they operate. Estimation of a circuit to operate at the specified speed requires an ability to measure, during the design process, its delay at numerous abstraction levels. Moreover, delay calculation must be incorporated into the inner loop of timing optimizations at various steps of design, such as logic synthesis, layout design, PNR (placement and routing), and in in-place optimizations performed late in the design cycle. There are high-end Industrial EDA tools available, but this paper addresses the need of a low-cost solution for STA. The paper proposes a novel aspect of an open-source EDA tool to find the critical path of Digital Design. The tool is developed using Python Language. The netlist format used for this tool is a modified version of gate level ISCAS netlist format which included the information on circuit structure and the gate and net delays can be provided by the user. The developed tool provides a visual impression of the design in the form of a directed acyclic graph (DAG) and highlights the critical path. The tool aims to provide assistance in digital designing for STA and help the designer provide modification in case of a timing violation (Setup or Hold).

articleTitle: Implementation of LED Linux Device Driver in STM32F407VGT6 Discovery Kit
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: The main aim of this paper is to study about interfacing STM32F407VGT6 controller with Linux operating system and how device driver code works to blink LED in the controller. To achieve this the STM controller is interfaced to Linux operating system using appropriate commands with the help of the command terminal. The device driver code for led blinking is also implemented through the terminal window. The operating system used is UBUNTU version 18.04.6. The microcontroller used is STM32F407VGT6 Discovery board, it is a 32bit microcontroller. The interfacing of controller with Linux is carried through the support of inbuilt ST-Link present in the controller. The device driver code is debugged and compiled using ARM cross platform compiler. This paper also discusses in brief about the command and its functions used in the Linux terminal. The successful implementation of the device driver code is verified using the LED output in controller.

articleTitle: Smart Self-Checkout System for Supermarkets
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: This paper deals with the implementation of selfcheckout software application, which is a 100% digital approach to offline shopping and aims to reduce the overall time required for shopping. This approach is implemented via bar code technology, real-time database and payment gateway. This software application aims to reduce time spent in shopping along with providing better security, self-pickup option and new wish list concept. This application skims through the barcodes of the products already present on each and every product and the user can exclusively select multiple products, finally bill will be generated which will be displayed to the user along with various payment options. The study concludes that the overall time for the basic work of super markets is minimized.

articleTitle: FPGA Based on Voting System along with Cross Voters Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: This article presents the FPGA Based on Voting System along with Cross Voters Detection using Python. The proposed system consists of three modules, namely the Vote Monitoring Module (VMM), Image Acquisition Module (IAM) and Image Detection Module, for casting and knowing the result of the election, image capturing purpose and Detecting the cross voters using facial recognition respectively. The Voting Unit (VMM) unit is implemented on FPGA(Zed board- ZYNQ 7000) using Verilog in such a way that consists three modules namely Button control module, Vote logger module and mode control. Button control module is used for casting the vote and knowing the result of each candidate. Mode control is used to choose the mode whether it is in voting mode or result mode and vote logger module is used to store the votes of each candidate separately. The Image acquisition module is used to detect the motion of the voter capture his face and vote casting image and that it sends to dedicated server for backup purpose and cross checking purpose. Simultaneously Image Detection Module (IDM) unit is used to check the cross voter images if it finds any cross voter face those will be removed and respective votes will treat as invalid votes. Those invalid votes will remove from genuine votes.

articleTitle: Li-Fi Implemented Data Transfer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: Light Fidelity (Li-Fi) is a budding technology that has emerged in several recent years, yet it needs further development and experimentation to prove its capability to be an alternative to Wi-Fi technology. Li-Fi uses light as a mode of transfer of data rather than the conventional radio frequencies that are inculcated in Wi-Fi. Li-Fi technology has crucial features differing from those of Wi-Fi, like its high data density in limited space and decreased interference issues as that of Wi-Fi. A wireless data transfer model is put together using two PCs and Li-Fi technology in this project. Data is transferred from the transmitter PC via an array of nine white LEDs connected to Arduino UNO. The data is transferred and received using an LED array and a photodiode respectively, each connected to an Arduino UNO, which in turn is connected to a PC. The Arduino boards encrypt and decrypt the data to be transferred using an algorithm mentioned further in the paper.

articleTitle: Understanding The Terminology Used In Malware Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: With the ongoing digitalization period coming into picture and quick progression, focusing on casualties by means of pernicious techniques like taking advantage of weakness or sending payload has acquired a spike. Malwares and pernicious assaults by means of them have flooded over the course of the last a few years. When it comes to malwares this era, threat actors are becoming sneaky by using crypting services to achieve complete undetectibility. In this paper, a meticulous study has been led on malware and terms related to malware, sorts of examination that is possible to analyze using different available tools on surface web, group of malwares, top malware attacks for the past 10 years, common infection methods used by threat actors to spread malware and how machine learning can be utilized for malware investigation and the future extent of reconciliation of machine learning for compelling examination and foresee more future missions. This paper will uncover all the terms related to malware and make a clear understanding of the terms.

articleTitle: Heart Disease Prediction based on Machine learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: Any condition that poses a significant risk to one’s life and affects the cardiovascular system is referred to as ‘‘cardiovascular disease Because of the potentially lethal nature of heart conditions, scientists are working to develop intelligent systems that can accurately diagnose these conditions using electronic health data and machine learning algorithms. These systems will be able to draw their information from electronic health records. In this article, to provide a number of different machine learning algorithms for the purpose of predicting cardiovascular disease based on an examination of the demographic and clinical data of patients. In the research article, a total of four distinct categorization approaches were discussed for the purpose of creating predictions. These included the Multilayer Perceptron (MLP), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest (RF), and Naive Bayes models (NB). The data were cleaned up, and then features were decided upon, before the models were constructed. When ranking the performance of the models, numerous other criteria, such as the F1-score, accuracy, precision, and recall, were utilized. The Logistic Regression Classifier was successful in achieving an overall score of 91.8%.

articleTitle: Raspberry Pi-based Vehicle Starter on Face Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: This paper gives a real-time approach to starting a vehicle using face detection and image processing using Rasp-berry Pi. In earlier, For various safety purposes, current systems make use of many forms of identification, including iris scanning, passwords, and fingerprints both transmitters and receivers are seldom used in systems to detect and initiate vehicles. The disadvantage of the current solutions is that not everyone will find them useful because few of them need the user to remember the password and even fewer make RF Id cards mandatory. The major flaw in the current system is that technology may even replace and change data at will. Our existing system can recognize the registered vehicle’s owner’s face and helps to start the vehicle. The car will remain off while the buzzer alert will go off if an illegal individual is detected. The authorized individual can add the car’s information to the device via the mobile app. The person’s photos recorded by the web camera attached to the central module are processed to carry out the detecting procedure. This approach is quite effective when implemented with a Raspberry Pi and image processing.

articleTitle: iAlert: An Alert System based on Eye Gaze for Human Assistance
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: People in this fast-growing world knowingly or unknowingly will suffer from various kinds of accidents. It might be severe or moderate. In severe cases, some patients may not be able to move their limbs. This work provides an assistive system for patients who cannot move from one place to another and who have injuries to their limbs but are not limited to cases of accidents. In this scenario, the only means for the patient to communicate is through eye movement or blinking. Eye tracking uses numerous technological procedures to measure eye movements, locations, and points of gaze. The primary goal of this research is to establish a human-computer interface for patients by tracking eye movement with an open-source webcam. In case of any need for the patient, an alarm system is designed to notify or alert the caretaker. When the patient wants to communicate, patient can make eye contact with the provided screen and then the caretaker will be notified. This low-cost eye tracking and eye gaze technology can be integrated into mobile phones and laptop, computers. The system shows good accuracy in finding out the need by the patient and alerting the caretaker through a mail.

articleTitle: Wall See Through Low-Velocity Moving Target Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: Since radar’s development, its use has widely increased for many applications, like wall-see-through detection, i.e., to look beyond the wall with Radio-Frequency (RF) technology for detecting objects like human beings. Wall-see-through technology is widely used for military and civil purposes. Wallsee-through detection faces numerous challenges like signal attenuation, measurement, mirror effect, etc. In the experiment, effect of the different dielectric material walls on RF signal propagation is investigated, i.e., attenuation of signal strength after it propagates through the given wall and absorption of signal within the wall occurs. For this, C-band pulse radar of GHz pulse repetition frequency (PRF) with on period of nanoseconds order is built. With this radar’s help, for different kind of walls experiment is conducted and measurement of the range and velocity of the trihedral reflector which is moved slowly by a human being. In the experiment with less available power, detection for maximum range until when Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) reduced substantially, such that it became impossible to identify the target out of match-filtered data. Velocity measurement is done with time delay-based range measurement.

articleTitle: FARMSUPPLY: Food Supply Chain Management using Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: The Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT) that underpins various crypto currencies may have a profound impact on the global economy. The Supply Chain Management (SCM) is one of the areas where the DLT is currently being used. By using the Distributed Ledger Technology, blockchain has the potential to vastly enhance different supply chains by facilitating faster and more cost-effective delivery of products. The main benefits of using blockchain in SCM is that it provides an enhancement technique for products traceability, improves coordination among the producer, manufacturer, distributor, retailer and consumer. Also, facilities easier access for funding. In the recent years, the Food Supply Chain (FSC) has been using the blockchain to utilize the benefits of SCM and provide better results for the Food Supply Chain. In this paper, a model is proposed, FARMSUPPLY, which uses blockchain in a Food Supply Chain to provide a better view of farmers, products and retailers. In this model, a Ethereum blockchain method and smart contract for the verification and validation of various attributes at each stage of the food supply chain is presented.

articleTitle: Quarantine Wristband Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: Abstract-The quarantine wristband is a wearable device that monitors the location of the patient and alerts when the person moves out of the quarantined area. It also measures the heart rate, blood oxygen level, and temperature of the patient wearing the band. It alerts when the patient needs an emergency on pressing the emergency button or SOS button. Also detects any tamper in the wearable device. All these data are then displayed and can be accessed in the cloud using the open-source IoT platform. The health department can access it and take the necessary action for those in need. This device may help the government better monitor and manage the quarantine of people during the pandemic. Wearable devices assist the subject in quarantine to comply with medical regimens and limitations; hence, a wearable band would be a good solution in this situation. A quarantine wristband using IoT (internet of things), that would detect and track the quarantine subjects in real-time was thus developed. This allows a patient in isolation to monitor his or her own health while simultaneously being accessible to health authorities. This Quarantine Wristband having a simple design was developed considering the cost, global supply chain disruption, and other factors.

articleTitle: 0I Can Cross If you are decelerating: Pedestrian-Vehicle Communication While Deciding To Cross
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: The majority of pedestrians signal their intentions to cars as they cross the street and attempt to gain their attention by giving them cues. These signals may be communicated to the vehicle either explicitly or indirectly. The preferred communication method and signal for pedestrians have not yet been determined. Determining whether or not to cross the street depends on how likely a collision is to occur given the environment and dynamic considerations. This video-based study shows that people prefer implicit communication to explicit cues, move their heads toward moving vehicles to judge speed, and signal their desire to cross the street unless they are doing so at a mid-block location. The findings indicate that vehicle speed is a key factor in the choice to cross since respondents feel confident doing so when the vehicle is moving slowly or is slowing down.

articleTitle: Automatic Roof for Crop/Seed Protection from Rains
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: Agriculture is the spine of our country. over it, nearly 70% of profit for our country are coming from agriculture. Nowadays, in the course of the wet seasons, the harvested plants get affected because of the heavy rainfall. The main goal of this task seems to be to protect the seedlings against intense or unusual rains. For automated rooftop construction, a rain detector is employed. This gadget entails protecting the seeds with the aid of using the automobile cover which can cover the complete place in which the crop is spread.

articleTitle: Cardiomyopathy Classification with Echocardiogram Videos Using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: Cardiomyopathy is a group of diseases that weaken the heart muscle making it harder for the heart to pump blood. Cardiomyopathy reduces blood output and may lead to heart failure. A variety of qualitative methods and measures have emerged to examine the cardiac function. However, the assessment of cardiomyopathy is bought to create a high progressive method with help of echocardiogram videos for the measurement of ejection fraction in the dilated left ventricle valve. Training on echo videos, proposed model accurately subdivides into three classes as normal, low ejection fraction and arrythmia. In the further analysis, using suitable deep learning techniques the CNN model provides high accuracy result, the evaluation metrics for multiclass classification include precision, recall, f1- score and confusion matrix with probability of 0.99. As a resource to promote great innovation we considered publicly available Econet-dynamic dataset of 195 annotated echocardiogram videos to predict the attack of cardiomyopathy. On model training and testing the CNN algorithm achieves 99.56% as overall accuracy score.

articleTitle: Violent Activity Type Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: This project aims to build a prediction model in R language using different machine learning algorithms such as KNN, decision tree and SVM. The target variable is attack type and weapon type thus this prediction model can predict attack type and weapon used. Project uses the Global Terrorism Database from 1970-2019. Project also provides some statistical data on different terrorist organization, types of attack, victims etc. The average accuracy attained by KNN is 83%, SVM 80% and Decision tree attained an accuracy of 81%. Thus, the proposedprogram is usefulfor accurate and precise prediction forfuture attacks and preparedness of the defense forces.

articleTitle: Advanced Vibration Analyzer of Motor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: Motor failure, which can be highly serious and result in a lot of downtime, is the main cause of industrial system failures. Continuous health monitoring, precise problem detection, and early engine failure warning are therefore necessary and cost-effective. Advanced signal processing techniques are needed to quickly identify and isolate defects in motor failures. Vibration monitoring is one of the most established and insightful techniques for assessing the technical state of equipment. This technique is employed for predictive motor maintenance. In this project, we will track motor vibration graph in real-time and analyze it to look for defects like wear faults. At the end, we had make assembling the hardware as well as software used for the measurement of motor vibration and an alarm system by using buzzer and a alert message on the monitoring screen which gets popped up when vibrations of the motor are excessive. This mechanism is curated in a way that it uses general equipment and software that most people are aware of.

articleTitle: Solar Fed Flood Alert System Using Arduino
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: The most destructive natural calamity in the world is flooding. In the event of a severe flood, it can obliterate the neighborhood and claim many lives. Billions of dollars would be spent by the government to rebuild the impacted area. In order to lower the risk of flooding, it is essential to construct a flood control system. In order to inform residents to take immediate action, such as fleeing to a safer and higher position, timely reporting on the occurrence of the flood is required. IoT-based flood warning systems are a desirable option for disaster management due to the development of Internet of Things (IoT) technology and the availability of inexpensive sensors. Flood monitoring and warning have been accomplished using a variety of IoT implementation techniques. This work provides a summary of the literature on IoT hardware implementation and the relevant solar fed flood warning system using Bolt Wi-Fi and Arduino tools. The paper makes a contribution by emphasizing the use of sensors, Arduino, wireless communication, IoT platforms, and Bolt Wi-Fi embracing IoT in flood monitoring and flood warning systems. This work gives prompt feedback by giving an alert and consequently any disaster can be avoided from in its beginning phases. Also, this system utilizes solar power as a source for the overall system thereby providing power consumption and increase the efficiency of the system. The proposed technique is tested using programming instrument Proteus 8 Professional.

articleTitle: Discrimination and Investigation of Cardiac Infarction gleaned from Various Machine Learning and Optimization Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: The analysis of data in medical field is frequently increasing for analyzing the diagnoses, various research methods need to be filtered, and adequate equipment need to be arranged according to the importance of the pathology that appear. In AI various classification of software are considered for presenting the data for best prediction. The basic system model made by us is pretty much capable of doing various data processing algorithms for analyzing various diseases of heart. Our model works basically on a specific category of data. This analysis basically allows us in obtaining a model prediction from training and then testing the data. Various optimizing techniques need to be used for classifying the present data which will help in predicting the best results. Our model’s main purpose is building a basic framework for exploring the cardiac infarction based on various distinct algorithms like DT, Random Forest, LR and KNN along with some data samples which we have examined both the training and testing purpose. Here for the effective diagnosis, the research is done using the dataset of heart disease which is provided by the UCI Machine Repository. After having training and testing, some optimization techniques like stochastic gradient descent method have also implemented in our model to find out the more refined outcome. As a result, we have gained as an approximation of 97.78% of classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Experimental Analysis on Sheep Tibia Bone under Various load condition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: There are numerous muscles and bones in the human body, it is observe that the human body is prone to a variety of damages as a result of the load types used in various cases. It mostly deal with static loads. As a result, the purpose of this article is to conduct an numerical analysis at the tibia bone, which is the original tibia bone. CAD software may be used to create a tibia bone model. This paper provides an real time load analysis on sheep tibia bone and the complete experiment is conducted using “Vertical Tension Machine” under various load condition. In this research work real time load analysis of tibia bone is presented and the objective is to get extrapolate the loading conditions of sheep bone into human tibia bone which helps in orthopedtion to diagnose patients properly.

articleTitle: Big Data Analytics for Electrical Systems using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: Big Data Analytics plays a vital role in every electrical industry to analyze the large amount of data received from their dispatch centers. Typically, Data retrieved from electrical systems like Generation, Transmission, and distribution will be analyzed using many control systems like SCADA and HMI without any human intervention. To analyze this data as per industry 4.0, Every system should be automated by integrating the data into the internet of things along with cyber security systems. With consideration of industry 4.0 standards, in view of effective optimized operational maintenance of electrical systems in the future, this paper provides intelligent predicted data by analyzing current and existing data that is fetching from electrical systems i.e., Various state electrical utility data files. The available data of electrical systems can be analyzed by using various Supervised Machine learning algorithms and this paper verified the accuracy of various machine learning algorithms by analyzing the predicted data by each algorithm.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Cordic based Digital Modulation Techniques using DPLL
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: This document delineates the implementation of Cordic based FPGA digital modulation techniques using DPLL for great-resolution digital communication applications. We are emphasizing upon digital phase lock loop-based Verilog-based code simulation for routinely adopted digital modulation techniques. In this work, based on the fundamental principles of sampling and quantization of DPLL digital signals, the sine wave which have been produced is smooth and plain in nature. Modelsim and Xilinx-ISE are used to run the simulation, which uses the VERILOG Hardware description language. A 32-bit serial data transmission system with self-adjusting carrier frequency and bit length has been developed.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Security of Online Voting System Using Defined Biometrics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: Voting is everyone’s right and one must vote according to his or her choice. Manual voting is not so secure and sometimes malpractices take place. So, there is a requirement for an online voting system. The manual voting system needs to shift to the online voting system. This project mainly aims to provide a secure and user-friendly online voting system. Aadhaar cards, fingerprints, and two-step verification are used in this web-based online voting system to provide high performance and high security to the voting system. Enough security is provided by using a biometric fingerprint, which lowers the number of fake votes. Python, HTML, self-made datasets and JavaScript are being used.

articleTitle: A New Side Channel Resistant Hybrid PUF Based Light Weight True Random Number Generator
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: In Crypthographic applications True Random number generator plays a crucial role. This work presents a new lightweight efficient and side channel resistant Field Programmable Gate array based Physically unclonnable Functions (PUF) and True random Number Generator which function based on glitches, re configurable delays and random jitter of Oscillators. To design complex secure True random number generator a novel PUF design is proposed which will generate random response with glitch, re configurable delays and Galoies fields..The proposed PUF has uniqueness of 49.96 %, worst case BER is0.35%, and reliability is about 99.7% irrespective of temperature and supply voltage variations. In addition to this clock jitter will also add an extra entropy. The proposed design implented on Xilinix Spartan-3A FPGA board. The Eight Stage Proposed PUF based TRNG consumed 272 LUTs and 84 FlipFops with 130 Slices. It has passed all the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) statistical tests with 7.3 Mbps throughput.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Android Controlled Multi-Tasking Humanoid Robot Using Raspberry PI 3
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: Humanoid robots are usually used in circumstances where human labor is impractical. This project will help people to get facilitated by a robot which will assist the visitor to any industry or institute to assist him/her with the different aspects. It will help guide to various departments of the concerned institute, give exact distance and directions, and will provide a full-pledged industry/institute MAP for visitors to navigate the institute freely without the help of any human. is capable of doing functions like walking, climbing upstairs and moving downstairs, live streaming, video recording, clicking photographs, obstacle avoiding, having information about its orientation, image processing, restriction, so it might be a 60-foot giant or a 2-footer. It is a smart humanoid robot of approximately 3 ft height which can be replaced by superior forces (almost everywhere). The humanoid is interesting because there is no size.

articleTitle: Available Transfer Capability Computation with or without considering Tie line Outages of an Interconnected Deregulated Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: The power sector is transiting toward the deregulated system which has created high competition in the electricity market with enormous power transfer activity. Available Transfer Capability (ATC) acts as an essential part of power system scheduling. In restructured power market, ATC gives valuable advice to the market participants as it can specify the available quantity of power which can be shifted among different parts over so far committed capacity. As power wheeling is rising nowadays, it is crucial to retain the details of ATC by Open Access Same-Time Information System (OASIS) on an hourly/daily/ monthly basis. ATC across a transmission line can illustrate what quantity of power can be transported by not disrupting anyone of the constraints across the transmission line so that the system can be robust to perform its operation. This paper contributes to ATC calculation in normal as well as outage conditions with the Continues Power Flow (CPF) method.

articleTitle: IoT Based Remote Monitoring of Gas Leakage in Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: Most of the electricity production in the emerging world is focused mainly on generation through power plants. This becomes more important in terms of security. It is important that good safety systems are implemented in training and workplaces. Due to the increasing number of poisonous gases, day by day and the need for minimum control of the pollution of dangerous gases, monitoring, and control of gas leakage are in need. The existing model in power plants and industry discusses the conventional monitoring of workers. The current model is based on microcontroller-based toxic gas detection and alarm systems and IoT industrial LPG and propane gas monitoring systems. The development system has an IOT-based gas and temperature monitoring system. Gas can be analyzed and monitored by the Blynk IoT server. The executive board receives an alarm when the pollution exceeds the critical limit.

articleTitle: The ‘Cryptness’ Website: Encryption and Data Security Practical Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: It has become a basic need in the modern day to save our personal information and financial information in a designated digital location. But, have ever pondered over the safety and security of our data, which in most valuable – as it can cause various crimes as well as can do deeds of a great importance and use. Here, comes the introduction of term named as ‘Cyber And Data Security’. This term can be effectively implemented by encrypting the user’s data, so that no one can handle or access the data except the verified user. This paper discusses about a website named as –‘Cryptness’ which implements the above process and securely stores the data and fetches it back to user whenever needed by using ‘Encryption And Cryptography’.

articleTitle: Unbounded Convergence based Channel Estimation in MIMO
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: State of art gadgets are developed as a result of technological developments which communicate information through diversified connections. The estimate technique presently is restricted to a specific type of interference only and does fail in the cases where there is change in the interference caused by diversity in the propagation model. Perhaps more in number are propagation models, more are observed co-channel interferences. To estimate interference of this type, Recursive Filters were recommended as these are characterized by low complexity and high convergence speed. Utilization of Recursive B-spline approximation (RBA) here gives superb solution. Perhaps we observe huge convergence delay under dynamic interference situation in communication along with the limitation of extrapolation due to defined cost function. The main aim of this paper is to develop a boundless estimation method with respect to Kalman filter stabilization for RBA. This technique describes an open bound for estimating the signal in order to achieve speed in convergence and also better accurate estimations.

articleTitle: An Electric Motor Powered Remote Controlled Heavier Than Air Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: to use technical principles to build an aircraft that can lift a large load while having a low self-weight. By including a detachable wing and tail piece, the aircraft’s design allows for modular construction. The landing gear is angled at a 2 degree angle to improve lift performance. A cambered airfoil is used for a better lift-to-drag ratio. An aircraft with high wings is created. The world is looking for a solution to immunize everyone on the earth due to the growing pandemic. We developed a strategy for effectively delivering the vaccination to remote places, The ability of the aircraft to carry 4 kg of payload allows for the storage of the vaccine in a dry ice box to maintain its temperature.

articleTitle: RBF-Neural Network Based Implementation of Sierpinski Carpet Shaped Fractal Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: This paper is about designing a Sierpinski carpet shaped fractal antenna using HFSS software and verifying with the Artificial Neural Network algorithm. The space filling and the self-similar property of fractal geometries helps to increase the electrical length and improve the bandwidth. The Sierpinski carpet antenna is designed for three different substrate thicknesses-l, 1.57, 3.2 mm and for different substrates such as FR4 Glass epoxy, Taconic TLC, RT Duroid, Bakelite, RO4003 with relative permittivity’s 4.4, 3.2, 2.2, 4. S and 3.55 respectively that would generate around 15 records of datasets. The data consists of input parameters like patch dimensions, dielectric constants and output parameters like return loss, frequency and bandwidth, which are used to train the AI model using RBF-ANN. Further, the AI model can be used to obtain the bandwidth efficiency for the desired applications. The Sierpinski antennas designed can operate in dual band and hence a single antenna can be used for multiple applications.

articleTitle: Analysis, Modelling, and Implementation of Point Contact Reay in Railway Relay Interlocking System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: The railway point, a crucial component of the moveable track in the architecture of the railway, is primarily responsible for the hazards of derailment and collision. A railway point is used to divert the train from one track to another track. In the relay interlocking system, the point contact relays play a crucial role. This paper presents the analysis, realization, and implementation of point contact relay in zed board.

articleTitle: Multi-Featured Cluster based Keyframe Extraction for Efficient Video Processing and Management
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: The amount of video content currently available in daily life has expanded enormously due to recent advancements in video capturing, storage, and distribution technologies. For efficient video processing, keyframe extraction is one of the main tasks to manage this voluminous video data. Various keyframe extraction techniques are used for video processing and management. However, clustering-based keyframe extraction techniques are the most popular for video content analysis due to their effectiveness, high robustness, and good feasibility. Many video summarization methods have utilized clustering-based keyframe extraction techniques; however, most of the existing techniques use a single feature to build the cluster such as histogram, color, shape, and many more. But clustering using more than one feature performs better than the one feature because a single feature may not distinguish between data points which can be resolved by incorporating multiple features. Thus, this paper proposes a Multi-Featured Cluster based Keyframe Extraction Method (MFCKEM) which uses color and shape features to build clusters. The K-means clustering algorithm is used to make clusters. However, the algorithm’s performance depends upon the k value and fixing the k value is challenging. For deciding the k value, a cluster validation approach named silhouette coefficient (SC) is used to decide the optimal number of clusters or k value. The performance of the proposed MFCKEM is evaluated using precision, recall, and F-measure. Moreover, the extracted keyframes are compared with the ground truth values provided in the dataset used for this experiment. The proposed model achieved precision, recall, and F-measure of 54.74%, 71.2%, and 59.09%, respectively, which are comparatively better than the existing keyframe extraction method that uses only color features.

articleTitle: Modal Analysis of MEMS Capacitive Accelerometer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: The accelerometer is an electromechanical device that measures acceleration forces. These forces may be static, like the constant force of gravity pulling at our feet, or they could be dynamic caused by moving or vibrating the accelerometer. In order to measure all these displacements is possible with accelerometer, the main objective of this paper is design and simulate microelectronic mechanical system accelerometer using COMSOL Multiphysics software, to obtain Eigen frequency in the range of 500Hz to 1000Hz and to obtain the displacement of accelerometer less than thickness of the MEMS accelerometer and capacitance of accelerometer combs in terms of Pico farad. The results obtained after implementing the MEMS accelerometer is 41.8F at the 0.94 $\mu$m displacement which is less than thickness of the MEMS accelerometer and Eigen frequency of 700 Hz which is suitable for the detection of intruders in borders.

articleTitle: A Review on Drive Selection, Converters and Control for Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: The rising consumption of fossil fuels, as well as the substantial environmental damage caused by them, have provided considerable motivation for the growth and progress of fuel-efficient automobiles. Efforts in research and development have been directed toward the creation of innovative concepts, low price systems, and dependable electric powertrains. This paper examines various configurations of electric vehicles (EVs) including hybrid electric vehicle (HEV), traction motors for the electric propulsion system, power converters employedin EVs/HEVs, and superior speed management of traction drive as well as sensorless control. Novel machine topologies providing potential efficiency benefits are also presented.

articleTitle: Integrated IoT Reference Architecture for Smart Metering and Monitoring of City Water Distribution Using Next Generation Sensors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Technology, Engineering, Management for Societal impact using Marketing, Entrepreneurship and Talent (TEMSMET)
abstract: Water has fundamental impoitance for life on earth. Adequate water supplies are essential for human consumption, agriculture, industry, and recreation.
